verdict.rationale: Kintsugi tracks transactions against nexus thresholds and can list nexuses and back-calculate when a threshold was crossed (kintsugi-docs-3, kintsugi-docs-11, kintsugi-docs-15), but the evidence describes retrospective detection ('finds the exposure you didn't know you had,' 'tells you when you crossed a threshold') rather than proactive, pre-crossing alerts across every state/country threshold as the story requires. missing for 10: explicit alerting/notification mechanism before a threshold is crossed, real-time dashboard or push-alert feature, evidence of country-level (vs. US state) threshold monitoring.
